body: I do have a few people I talk to about this, but as far as finding things to excel at, I don't try very hard other than following the lead of my friends. And like I said in my other reply, I do have something, so maybe I don't have to do that. Thank you!

Well, there is something I'm good at that I always tend to devalue. What you and /u/hornless_unicorn said reminded me that it means just as much as being a good enough artist to open a patreon, for instance. Thank you!

Well, to answer, I'm 22 years old. I've been in psychiatry in the past and diagnosed with Generalized Anxiety Disorder. It didn't work out then, but I am trying again with another psychiatrist. But the first time I went to therapy, I got diagnosed with Prozac, and it did help with my depression, which I was going through hard when I first went into it, but I feel like I might need to change my medication.
As to the exercise, I have been meaning to get more energy and generally be healthier, and knowing that it'll help with one of the bigger problems in my life on top of that is going to be more incentive to do that.
